name: Electric Bicycle
description: A bicycle with fully operable pedals and an electric motor of less than 750 watts, in one of three classes: Class 1 pedal assist to 20 mph, Class 2 throttle to 20 mph, and Class 3 pedal assist to 28 mph.

restrictions.rule: Class 1 and Class 3 assist only while the rider pedals, cutting out at 20 and 28 mph; Class 2 may be propelled by the motor alone, to 20 mph
Class 1 and 3 motors stop when the rider stops pedaling; a Class 2 motor stops when the brakes are applied
Carries a permanent label, in at least 9-point type, stating its class, top assisted speed and motor wattage
Must not be modified to change its motor-powered speed or engagement unless the label is replaced to match
Meets the CPSC's bicycle requirements (16 CFR part 1512)
Class 3 riders must be 16 or older; a younger passenger may ride on one designed to carry passengers
Class 3 riders and passengers under 21 must wear a bicycle helmet meeting 16 CFR part 1203, and a Class 3 must have a speedometer
Class 1 and Class 2 may ride bicycle and multi-use paths where bicycles are allowed, but the local authority over a path may ban them
Class 3 is kept off bicycle and multi-use paths unless the path runs within or beside a road or the local authority allows it
In state parks, Class 1 may ride any trail designated for bicycles; Class 2 and 3 may ride park roads but not mountain bike or multi-use trails
Has the rights and duties of a bicycle and is not a motor vehicle: no driver's license, registration, title or insurance
Excluded from Arkansas's motorized bicycle definition
